products.name: Organic Cuticle Revitalizing Elixir - Rose & Lavender
products.description: Cold-pressed botanical oil blend with Sweet Almond, Jojoba, Vitamin E, and organic rosehip extract to deeply nourish dehydrated cuticles and strengthen the natural nail matrix.

products.name: Japanese Non-Wipe Mirror Glass Top Coat
products.description: Ultra-high gloss gel top coat formula designed in Tokyo. Scratch-resistant, non-yellowing, and requires no cleansing wipe for an instant showroom mirror finish.

products.name: Hydrating Shea Butter & Collagen Hand Treatment Mask
products.description: Intensive spa glove infusion infused with organic shea butter, marine collagen, and hyaluronic acid for silky-soft hands and radiant skin tone.

products.name: Bespoke Milky Nude Soak-Off Polish Trio Collection
products.description: Curated set of 3 quintessential sheer-to-medium nude gel shades crafted for the modern clean girl aesthetic and milky French manicures.

products.name: Precision Surgical Steel Cuticle Nipper 4mm
products.description: Hand-honed German stainless steel jaw for clean, snag-free precision trims around the nail folds. Autoclave and sterilizer safe.

products.name: Korean Magnetic 9D Cat Eye Velvet Gel - Rose Aura
products.description: Ultra-dense micro-magnetic particles create a celestial dimensional galaxy shift under magnetic styling wands. Smooth salon self-leveling formula.

products.name: Aesthetic 3D Nail Charms & Crystal Aurora Box
products.description: Assorted collection of 120+ micro metallic bows, iridescent pearls, and Swarovski-grade faceted crystals for statement 3D nail art.

products.name: Professional Smart UV/LED Dual Lamp 48W
products.description: Salon-grade 48W dual-light wavelength curing lamp with digital timer display, low heat mode, and magnetic detachable base plate for pedicure use.

products.name: Dead Sea Salt Exfoliating Foot & Body Scrub
products.description: Enriched with peppermint, eucalyptus, and mineral-rich Dead Sea crystals to buff away calluses and revive tired, aching feet.

products.name: Keratin & Calcium Intensive Nail Fortifier Treatment
products.description: Clinically proven base treatment that mends peeling, brittle, or cracked natural nails after long-term gel wear in 14 days.

products.name: Chrome Holographic Mirror Powder Set - 4 Chrome Pigments
products.description: High-purity nano pigment flakes for mermaid, glazed donut, sunset gold, and silver chrome finishes. Includes 8 applicator sponges.

products.name: Nano Glass Ultra-Shine Nail Buffer & File Duo
products.description: Gentle etched micro-glass surface shapes nails without splintering and buffs nail plate to an instant natural glass shine lasting up to 2 weeks.
